plan: Define a module-level frozen initial-session template dict; begin and abandon rebuild self.session by copying it, guaranteeing the exact four-key shape and clean resets.
Route handle() through a dispatch table mapping the six action-type strings to private handler methods; non-dict actions and unknown types short-circuit to an error screen.

Enforce validate-then-mutate in every handler: all precondition and payload checks (active/incomplete gates, bool checks via isinstance, appointment-id membership) run before any session write, so invalid actions cannot corrupt accepted data and never raise.

Centralize screen construction in _screen(prompt, messages), which derives choices: copies of the appointments (preserving input order) exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment', otherwise an empty list.
Compute post-correction prompts with _next_prompt(): 'Confirm contact' until contact_confirmed is True, then 'Choose appointment' until an appointment is selected, then 'Review and complete'.
Build error screens with prompt 'Error' and a single message beginning 'Error: ', keeping choices empty by construction.

Inject action_source and screen_sink through the constructor as duck-typed ports; run_once raises RuntimeError before calling either if one is missing, then reads one action, handles it, displays the resulting screen exactly once, and returns that same object.
Copy the appointments sequence (and each entry's id/label) at construction so later caller mutations cannot affect emitted choices.
mechanisms: Frozen initial-session template copied for construction, begin, and abandon
Dispatch table from action type to handler method
Centralized screen builder deriving choices from the prompt value
Error screens with reserved 'Error' prompt and 'Error: '-prefixed first message
Constructor-injected duck-typed action source and screen sink ports
Defensive copying of the appointments sequence at construction
